title: SIRMES hunger-strike picket at Hospital de Clínicas, La Paz
reason: Opened contemporaneous reports describe an initial four-doctor hunger-strike picket and a five-person group; no separate public gathering of at least 50 participants is evidenced. This began in September and is not an October-onset event.
limitations: Exact initial date is not directly fixed by the reviewed reports; date range is approximate and excluded from eligible October starts.
